```python
# Get top-rated car rental companies in London and Paris
car_rental_companies_london = get_car_types_available(["London"])
car_rental_companies_paris = get_car_types_available(["Paris"])

# Get top-rated restaurants in London and Paris
restaurants_london = get_all_restaurants_in_city("London")
restaurants_paris = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get top-rated hotels in London and Paris
hotels_london = get_all_hotels_in_city("London")
hotels_paris = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

# Get prices for car rental companies, restaurants, and hotels
car_rental_prices_london = get_car_price_per_day(list(car_rental_companies_london.keys()))
car_rental_prices_paris = get_car_price_per_day(list(car_rental_companies_paris.keys()))
restaurant_prices_london = get_price_for_restaurants(list(restaurants_london.split(", ")))
restaurant_prices_paris = get_price_for_restaurants(list(restaurants_paris.split(", ")))
hotel_prices_london = get_hotels_prices(list(hotels_london.split(", ")))
hotel_prices_paris = get_hotels_prices(list(hotels_paris.split(", ")))

# Calculate total maximum expense for the 5-day trip
total_expense = 0
for i in range(5):
    if i < 2:
        total_expense += max(car_rental_prices_london.values()) * 2  # assuming 2 meals per day
        total_expense += max(restaurant_prices_london.values()) * 2
        total_expense += max(hotel_prices_london.values())
    else:
        total_expense += max(car_rental_prices_paris.values()) * 2
        total_expense += max(restaurant_prices_paris.values()) * 2
        total_expense += max(hotel_prices_paris.values())

print("Top-rated car rental companies in London: ", list(car_rental_companies_london.keys()))
print("Top-rated car rental companies in Paris: ", list(car_rental_companies_paris.keys()))
print("Top-rated restaurants in London: ", list(restaurants_london.split(", ")))
print("Top-rated restaurants in Paris: ", list(restaurants_paris.split(", ")))
print("Total maximum expense for the 5-day trip: ", total_expense)
```
